archetypes.purpose: Compares multi-variable data sets using side-by-side scatter plots to highlight specific quadrants and temporal shifts.
archetypes.directive: Split layout into two vertical halves below a primary header. Place a scatter plot in each half, featuring a subtitle and explanatory text above. Left plot uses a shaded background box for emphasis; right plot uses directional arrows between paired nodes.

units.name: scatter-plot
units.anatomy: A coordinate grid with labeled axes, a legend, and multiple circular data points of varying sizes.

archetypes.furniture: Top horizontal rule, primary title, bottom source block, page number, and brand logo.

archetypes.name: dual-period-bubble-rank-shift
archetypes.purpose: Visualizes shifts in ranking and magnitude between two time periods using a bubble matrix and directional connectors.
archetypes.directive: Arrange two parallel horizontal rows of bubbles representing distinct time periods. Align bubbles vertically to category labels on top and bottom axes. Use color-coded dotted arrows to link corresponding categories between rows to indicate movement.

units.name: Ranked Bubble
units.anatomy: A sized circle with an internal percentage label, mapped to a category column and a temporal row.

archetypes.furniture: Header includes eyebrow text, title, and legend; footer contains a full-width highlighted text box and source metadata.

archetypes.name: circular-bubble-data-viz
archetypes.purpose: Visualizes proportional data points in a cluster alongside a summary list.
archetypes.directive: Place a vertical text block on the left with a numbered list and summary paragraphs. On the right, arrange circles of varying diameters in a clockwise spiral around a central focal point. Each circle must include a centered percentage, an adjacent icon in a small circle, and an external text label.

units.name: summary-list-item
units.anatomy: A numbered text line followed by a bold category name.

units.name: data-bubble
units.anatomy: A colored circle containing a percentage, paired with a small icon badge and an external text label.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left category tag, bold header, sub-header, and bottom-aligned source/date text.

archetypes.name: labeled-bubble-chart-with-trendline
archetypes.purpose: Correlates two quantitative metrics across multiple entities while using bubble size for a third dimension.
archetypes.directive: Center a large rectangular coordinate system with labeled X and Y axes and a dashed linear trendline. Plot colored bubbles of varying sizes, each with a small text label positioned immediately adjacent. Place a multi-column color legend above the chart and a bold title block at the top.

units.name: Data Bubble
units.anatomy: A circular node of variable diameter and color with an associated text label.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left exhibit label, bold header, sub-header, horizontal legend, and bottom-right page number with logo.

archetypes.name: staggered-thumbnail-methodology
archetypes.purpose: Outlines a three-step methodology using visual previews of related slides or documents.
archetypes.directive: Arrange three thumbnail images along a horizontal axis connected by a thin line with circular nodes. Stagger the thumbnails so the outer two are below the line and the center one is above. Each thumbnail must be flanked by descriptive text blocks above and below.

units.name: methodology-step
units.anatomy: A vertical stack of a text paragraph, a shadowed image thumbnail, and a bold title.

archetypes.furniture: Header contains title, subtitle, and logo; a horizontal callout bar sits below the header; footer includes copyright and a decorative bar.

archetypes.name: alternating-process-pathway
archetypes.purpose: Illustrates a multi-stage methodology using thumbnail previews of specific deliverables along a chronological axis.
archetypes.directive: Center a horizontal timeline with circular nodes across the slide. Alternate thumbnail images above and below the line at each node. Place a bold title and descriptive text block opposite each thumbnail relative to the timeline.

units.name: Methodology Step
units.anatomy: Consists of a drop-shadowed thumbnail image, a bold header, a text paragraph, and a corresponding timeline node.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left aligned title and subtitle, top-right logo, and a standard footer with copyright and accent bar.

archetypes.name: zigzag-thumbnail-process-flow
archetypes.purpose: Illustrates a multi-stage methodology by alternating text descriptions and slide previews along a central horizontal axis.
archetypes.directive: Draw a horizontal line across the center with circular nodes. Alternate content blocks above and below the line. Each block contains a bold header, a text paragraph, and a bordered image thumbnail in a vertical stack.

units.name: process-node
units.anatomy: A vertical stack of a bold title, body text, and a rectangular thumbnail image.

archetypes.furniture: Header contains title, subtitle, and logo; footer includes copyright text and a small geometric accent.

archetypes.name: alternating-thumbnail-methodology-flow
archetypes.purpose: Maps a multi-stage methodology using slide previews and text descriptions along a central axis.
archetypes.directive: Place a horizontal line across the center with circular nodes. Alternate units above and below the line. Each unit contains a drop-shadowed thumbnail and a text block, with text always positioned between the image and the timeline.

units.name: Methodology Step
units.anatomy: A vertical stack of a slide thumbnail and descriptive text alternating above and below a central axis.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left title and subtitle, top-right logo, and a thin footer with copyright and confidentiality text.

archetypes.name: chevron-stage-focus-cards
archetypes.purpose: Details a specific phase of a linear process through descriptive text and visual examples.
archetypes.directive: Place a horizontal process bar with three chevrons at the top, highlighting the active stage. Below, split the layout into a left-aligned text sidebar and a right-aligned row of vertical cards. Each card must contain a dark header, a central image, and a grey text footer.

units.name: Process Chevrons
units.anatomy: A chevron shape containing a centered icon and label.

units.name: Example Cards
units.anatomy: A vertical stack consisting of a dark title bar, a rectangular image, and a grey descriptive footer.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left title, top-right logo cluster, bottom-left source text, and bottom-right page number.

archetypes.name: numbered-recap-columns
archetypes.purpose: Summarizes multiple workstreams or phases using numbered columns containing slide thumbnails and descriptive text.
archetypes.directive: Divide the slide into three equal vertical columns, each topped with a large, semi-transparent background numeral. Place a framed slide thumbnail in the upper half of each column, followed by a bold sub-header and a paragraph of body text. Maintain consistent horizontal alignment for all elements across the columns.

units.name: Recap Column
units.anatomy: A large background number sits behind a framed image thumbnail, followed by a centered bold title and a block of justified body text.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left title and subtitle, top-right logo, bottom-left footer text, and bottom-right page number.

archetypes.name: dark-three-column-process-previews
archetypes.purpose: Summarizes three process components using icons, text, and visual thumbnails.
archetypes.directive: Arrange three vertical columns under a top-aligned title block. Each column contains a circular icon on a central horizontal axis, a numbered heading, a text body, a downward chevron, and a bordered image thumbnail. Use a dark theme with accent colors for headings.

units.name: process-column
units.anatomy: Vertical stack of a circular icon, numbered title, description text, chevron icon, and a framed image preview.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left title and subtitle, top-right logo, bottom-left copyright, and bottom-right page number.

archetypes.name: waterfall-chart-with-annotated-list

archetypes.directive: Split slide into two vertical zones. Left zone contains a dark header, italicized sub-header, and a list of items grouped by external brackets. Right zone features a waterfall chart with dashed connectors, callout bubbles, and a bottom summary text area.

units.name: list-item

units.name: waterfall-bar

units.name: callout-bubble

archetypes.name: waterfall-breakdown-sidebar
archetypes.purpose: Breaks down a total value into components using a waterfall chart and summary text.
archetypes.directive: Place a waterfall chart on the left with dashed connectors between bars. Add floating callout bubbles to specific bars. Position a large, bordered text box on the right for key takeaways.

units.name: waterfall-bar
units.anatomy: Vertical bar with a bottom label and top percentage range.

units.name: callout-bubble
units.anatomy: Rounded rectangle with a pointer tail containing descriptive text.

archetypes.furniture: Top-right logos, breadcrumb bar, dark title bar with icon, and bottom-right page number.

archetypes.name: waterfall-breakdown-with-categorized-list
archetypes.purpose: Breaks down a total value into components using a waterfall chart and a categorized list.
archetypes.directive: Divide slide into two vertical halves. Left half contains a dark header box above a list of items grouped by vertical brackets. Right half features a waterfall chart with percentage labels, a callout box, and a summary text area at the base.

units.name: list-item
units.anatomy: Icon and bold text on a light horizontal strip.

units.name: waterfall-bar
units.anatomy: Vertical bar with percentage label above and category label below.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left title, top-right logo group, bottom-left source, and bottom-right page number.

archetypes.name: dual-pane-financial-breakdown
archetypes.purpose: Breaks down cost structures into categorical lists and a visual waterfall distribution.

units.name: labeled-category
units.anatomy: Vertical label adjacent to a text block and a grid of icon-labeled cells.

units.name: waterfall-bar
units.anatomy: Vertical bar with dashed connectors and percentage labels.

units.name: floating-list
units.anatomy: Rounded container with a bulleted list pointing to a chart element.

archetypes.furniture: Top title, right-side logo cluster, breadcrumb indicators, and bottom-right page number.

archetypes.name: triple-stacked-bar-to-detailed-callout

archetypes.directive: Split the slide into three vertical columns with colored headers. Each column contains a stacked bar chart connected by a shaded trapezoid to a detailed vertical list of sub-components. Ensure consistent alignment of labels and values across all three columns.

units.name: Comparison Column
units.anatomy: Header with logo, stacked bar chart, and a trapezoidal expansion to a detailed text-and-value list.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left icon box, top-right logo cluster, bottom legend, and bottom-left source notes.

archetypes.name: waterfall-chart-right-panel

units.anatomy: Vertical bar with a numeric value and a bottom category label.

archetypes.furniture: Top-left title with accent line, bottom-right page number, and small logo.

archetypes.name: waterfall-bridge-with-metric-rows
archetypes.purpose: Decomposes a total value into categorical contributors while providing secondary growth metrics in a bottom-aligned grid.
archetypes.directive: Position a waterfall chart in the top half with floating bars connected by dashed lines, terminating in a full-height summary bar. Align a horizontal row of icons and labels directly beneath the chart columns. Add two rows of circular percentage badges at the bottom, keyed to the vertical columns.

units.name: Waterfall Bar
units.anatomy: A rectangular block with an internal or top-aligned numeric value, connected to the next unit by a dashed horizontal line.

units.name: Category Column
units.anatomy: A vertical stack containing an icon, a text label, and two circular metric badges.
